info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Operational Services Customer Billing By Customer Billing Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Customer Billing Retrieval API allows users to access specific customer billing information based on a unique billing identifier. This endpoint serves financial institutions and service providers looking to efficiently retrieve and integrate billing details for customer accounts. Developers can utilize this API to enhance their applications with accurate billing data or provide customer support teams with quick access to billing records. Use cases include generating customer billing reports, facilitating customer inquiries, and ensuring seamless financial operations.

get.summary: Retrieve billing information for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the billing details of a customer identified by their unique customer ID. It returns all relevant billing information required for review or processing.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to retrieve billing information for the specified customer. Ensure that the customer's unique identifier is accurately provided to receive the correct billing data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning customer billing details.
